name: Zhao Ming, the Iron Dragon
canonNotes: Dragon son of the Celestial Emperor and governor of the Western Provinces, famed for his martial ambition and mastery of war machines.
Hungers for conquest to the west and for glory in his father's eyes.
voiceNotes: Martial, ambitious and commanding; speaks of iron, conquest and duty.
Respects strength and reliability in allies.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
